Sir, 

According to a report submitted by Teng Ching-ming ( } 
Chief of our Detective Branch, stating that on March 30, from 
information furnished by Liu Ngoh-nien ( ), Chief of 
the Radio Station attached to General Military Headjzuarters, 
regarding a secret radio station established by agents of 
the 4th Army Group at 180 Wuting Road in coiamunication with 
troops ut Wuhan, we dispatched detectives Peng Pei-wei ( ) 
and others, accompanied by the informant, to your Police 
Department, and,with your a:sistance, these detectives 
visited the address given but found no trace of a wireless 
station. Further information was to the effect that 
secret wirless stations were also established at 17 Haining 
Road and at 3/4 Tao Yuen Tseng, Rue Lafayette, French 
Concession. A raid was made at the latter address on March 28, 
but proved fruitless. 

It was later learned that these agemts had removed all 
wireless apparatus at the aforesaid places on March 28 and 29 
to 24 Tongshan Road, Settlement. Then we again sent detective 
Peng and others with the informant to approach your officers 
CeDeI. Robertson and Clerical a: cistant Tan Shao-liang who 
soon proceeded to 24 Tongshan Road with them. There, after 
careful investigation, three sets of wireless apparatus and a 
lot of accessories were found and detained at your Station. 

We greatly appreciate your good services in making this raid 
successfulé but we would request you to kindly hand over thése 


sets to us to be deait with and greatly oblige. 


(Sd.) Hsiung Shih-hui

During the examination of our find, Mr. Tsui Chan-yun

responsibility for the presence in the Settlement of these 
wireless sets. He agreed with me that his action in 
transmitting messages from the Wuting Road house constituted

He also agreed with my suggestion that the Municipal Police

Station had previously intimated that nis instructions from 
Banking were to secure the cooperation of the Municipal 
Police in preventing the 4th Army Group from using the 
International Settlement as a base for the transmission of 
wireless messages. No arrests, Mr. Liu added, were asked for.

station (Wuting Road and Rue Lafayette) had four operators

Wireless sets and paraphernalia of the 4th

Tongshan Road on March 30, 1929.

This property was yesterday handed over in the presence of
Superintendent Fairbairn to Messrs Liu Ngoh-nien (劉鶴年)
and Chen Yung-kuang (成容光) of the Shanghai Short Wave
Radio Station and two representatives from the Defence
Commissioner's Headquarters who were armed with the attached
dispatch from General Hsiung.

Mr. Liu appended his signature to the list of property

would request General Hsiung to forward a formal acknowledgment

（刑事调查处）办公笔记 档案号 80. A. 146.
1929年4月25日。

1929年3月30日，工部局警务处在唐山路24.D号查获第四集团军的无线电台及配件。

昨日，在费尔贝恩（Fairbairn）巡官的见证下，上述财产已移交给上海短波电台的刘鹤年先生和成容光先生，以及淞沪卫戍司令部的两名代表，后者持有附上的熊式辉将军的公函。

刘先生已在财产清单（见附件档案）上签字以示收讫，并表示将请求熊式辉将军出具正式收据。

淞沪卫戍司令部致上海公共租界工部局警务处的第48号公函译文，日期为1929年4月23日。

先生：

关于在唐山路24d号一处住宅进行的搜查行动，结果缴获了一批无线电设备，现经向资深领事（美国总领事）提出请求并获批准，将上述设备移交我方。因此，我特派本处侦探科科长邓警铭先生前往贵处，安排移交事宜。如蒙应允，不胜感激。

熊式辉
（签名及盖章）

Master of Shanghai Short Wave Radio Station (a branch of

General Hsiung is absolutely no hand in the discovery of

leave the custody of the Municipal Police without the

（刑事调查处）办公笔记
29.4.21.

第四集团军的无线电台

为了维护租界的中立地位，工部局警务处根据与代表第四集团军的崔赞云先生以及上海短波电台（南京军事总部下属机构）台长刘鹤年先生达成的协议，接管了这批财产。除了派遣两人陪同刘先生前往工部局警务处总部外，熊式辉将军在此次物资的发现过程中完全未参与；事实上，如果我们在调查中依赖其属下的指引，这些电台根本不会被发现。

刘鹤年先生私下告知我，此事与熊式辉将军毫无关系，然而，熊将军无疑会试图通过促使租界当局经由他将电台归还，来为自己捞取一点廉价的功劳。刘先生强烈表示，在他所代表的南京军事总部知情并书面批准之前，这些电台不得脱离工部局警务处的保管。

Translation of Dispatch No. 43 from the
Headquarters of the Woosung-Shanghai
Defence Commissioner to Shanghai Municipal
Police Headquarters, dated April 1, 1929.

Sir,

According to a report submitted by Teng Ching-ming (        ),
Chief of our Detective Branch, stating that on March 30, from
information furnished by Liu Ngoh-nien (        ), Chief of
the Radio Station attached to General Military Headquarters,
regarding a secret radio station established by agents of
the 4th Army Group at 180 Wuting Road in communication with
troops at Wuhan, we dispatched detectives Peng Pei-wei (        )
and others, accompanied by the informant, to your Police
Department, and, with your assistance, these detectives
visited the address given but found no trace of a wireless
station. Further information was to the effect that
secret wireless stations were also established at 17 Haining
Road and at 3/4 Tao Yuen Tseng, Rue Lafayette, French
Concession. A raid was made at the latter address on March 28,
but proved fruitless.

It was later learned that these agents had removed all
wireless apparatus at the aforesaid places on March 28 and 29
to 24 Tongshan Road, Settlement. Then we again sent detective
Peng and others with the informant to approach your officers
C.D.I. Robertson and Clerical Assistant Tan Shao-liang who
soon proceeded to 24 Tongshan Road with them. There, after
careful investigation, three sets of wireless apparatus and a
lot of accessories were found and detained at your Station.
We greatly appreciate your good services in making this raid
successful; but we would request you to kindly hand over these
sets to us to be dealt with and greatly oblige.

(Sd.) Hsiung Shih-hui
(Chopped) Defence Commissioner and General.

（批：Suggest reply on the lines of attached draft.）
（印：OFFICE OF COMMISSIONER OF DEFENCE SHANGHAI APR 2 1929）

先生：

据我处侦探科科长邓警铭（        ）提交的报告称，3月30日，根据隶属于军事总部电台台长刘鹤年（        ）提供的信息，得知第四集团军特工在吴淞路180号设立了一个秘密电台，与武汉部队进行通讯，我们遂派遣侦探彭佩伟（        ）等人，由线人陪同，前往贵警务处，并在你们的协助下，这些侦探走访了所给的地址，但未发现电台踪迹。进一步的消息表明，在海宁路17号以及法租界拉斐特路（今复兴中路）陶元增3/4号也设立了秘密无线电台。3月28日对后一地址进行了突击搜查，但一无所获。

后获悉，这些特工已于3月28日和29日将上述地点的所有无线电设备转移至租界内的唐山路24号。于是我们再次派遣彭侦探等人携线人接触贵处刑事调查主任罗伯逊（Robertson）及文书助理谭少良，他们随即与他们一同前往唐山路24号。在那里，经过仔细调查，发现了三套无线电设备及大量配件，并扣押在贵局。我们对贵方促成此次搜查成功的良好服务深表感谢；但恳请贵方将这些电台移交给我们要进行处理，不胜感激。

（签名） 熊式辉
（盖章） 卫戍司令兼将军。

（批：建议按所附草稿回复。）
（印：上海卫戍司令办公室 1929年4月2日）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 146
File No. 2-4-29

(C.I.D.) Office Notes
March 31, 1929.

Breach of Settlement Neutrality.
4th Army Group (General Li Chung-jen)
transmitting wireless messages from
base in the International Settlement.

On the information of Mr. Liu Ngoh-nien (劉鶴年),
Master of Shanghai Short Wave Radio Station (a branch of
Nanking Military Headquarters) that the 4th Army Group
(General Li Chung-jen) were transmitting wireless messages
from a house in Wuting Road, I, together with P.C.S. Read
and representatives from the Defence Commissioner's
Headquarters and the Shanghai Short Wave Radio Station,
proceeded to No. 20 Wuting Road, a Chinese dwelling, at
noon on March 30. We found traces of a wireless apparatus
having been installed there and on investigation learned
that it had been removed by motor car at 2 o'clock that
morning. Further enquiry led us to an unoccupied semi-foreign
house at 37 Baining Road, the lease of which the 4th Army
Group were endeavouring to secure, but nothing was found
there. Returning to Wuting Road we were eventually
successful in locating the chauffeur of the public hire car
used in the transportation of the set. At this point
Yung Ling-hsiang (榮麟祥), tenant of the house, arrived on the scene,
and seeing the chauffeur and observing that his younger
brother and another visitor had given Tongshan Road as the
destination of the set, he confessed that, as a result of
a warning conveyed to him by a spy at the Defence Commission-
-er's Headquarters, he had had the set moved to 24.D.
Tongshan Road. On visiting this house, an unoccupied foreign
dwelling, we found the missing set together with another
set which had been hurriedly removed from a house on Rue
Lafayette on March 27 just prior to a raid on it by the
French Police and Chinese Authorities. Warning of this
raid was given by some member or agent of the French Police.
In addition to these two sets, a third brand new set was
also found together with three receiving sets, motors,

（刑事调查处）办公笔记
1929年3月31日。

违反租界中立。
第四集团军（李宗仁将军）
从国际租界内的基地发送无线电报。

根据上海短波电台（南京军事总部下属机构）台长刘鹤年先生的情报，称第四集团军（李宗仁将军）正在吴淞路的一处房屋内发送无线电报，我于3月30日中午，会同警务处特别分部里德（Read）警官、卫戍司令部代表以及上海短波电台代表，前往吴淞路20号，这是一处华人住宅。我们发现那里曾安装过无线电设备的痕迹，经调查得知，该设备已于当天凌晨2点由汽车运走。进一步的查询将我们引向海宁路37号的一栋空置的半西式房屋，第四集团军正试图租赁该房屋，但在那里一无所获。返回吴淞路后，我们最终成功找到了用于运输该设备的出租车的司机。此时，该房屋的租户荣麟祥到达现场，看到司机并注意到他的弟弟和另一位访客将该设备的目的地说成是唐山路，他承认，由于收到卫戍司令部一名间谍发出的警告，他已将设备移至唐山路24.D号。在走访这栋空置的外国人住宅时，我们发现了失踪的设备，以及另一套设备，这套设备是在3月27日法国警察和中国当局突击搜查拉斐特路的一处房屋之前，匆忙从那里移走的。这次突击搜查的警告是由法国警察局的某成员或特工发出的。除了这两套设备外，还发现了一套全新的设备以及三套接收机、马达，

accumulators, etc., as per attached detailed list.
During the examination of our find, Mr. Tsui Chan-yun
(崔雲章), Engineer of the Communication Department of the
4th Army Group Headquarters, arrived and accepted full
responsibility for the presence in the Settlement of these
wireless sets. He agreed with me that his action in
transmitting messages from the Wuting Road house constituted
a breach of the neutrality of the International Settlement.
He also agreed with my suggestion that the Municipal Police
should, as a measure to prevent a recurrence, take charge
of the sets for the time being. Mr. Liu of the Radio
Station had previously intimated that his instructions from
Nanking were to secure the cooperation of the Municipal
Police in preventing the 4th Army Group from using the
International Settlement as a base for the transmission of
wireless messages. No arrests, Mr. Liu added, were asked for.
It was learned from Mr. Tsui Chan-yun that the French
Concession set had been operating for about a month but
Wuting Road only commenced working on March 27. Each
station (Wuting Road and Rue Lafayette) had four operators
who received a salary of $80 per month.
Mr. Tsui Chan-yun held that the entire property belonged
to General Li Chung-jen, as representing the 4th Army Group,
but Mr. Liu contended that General Li at the time he
purchased the sets represented the Nanking Government and
that therefore Nanking was actually the owner. I pointed
out that the question of ownership was one with which the
Municipal Police were not concerned, and both agreed that
temporary detention of the property by the Municipal Police
was the best solution.
The Acting D. C.I. was informed how matters stood and
he gave instructions that the entire lot of wireless sets
and paraphernalia be removed to the Eastern Depot in
pages.zh:

蓄电池等，详见所附清单。
在检查我方查获物品期间，第四集团军总部通讯处工程师崔雲章先生抵达现场，并对这些无线电台出现在租界一事承担全部责任。他同意我的看法，即其从吴庭路（Wuting Road）寓所发送电报的行为构成了对国际租界中立地位的破坏。他也同意我的建议，即为防止此类事件再次发生，工部局警务处应暂时保管这些电台。无线电台的刘先生此前曾暗示，他接获南京方面的指示，要求争取工部局警务处的合作，以阻止第四集团军利用国际租界作为发射无线电信号的基地。刘先生补充说，并未要求逮捕任何人。
据崔雲章先生告知，法租界的电台已运作约一个月，而吴庭路的电台直至3月27日才开始工作。每个电台（吴庭路和拉斐特路）各有四名报务员，月薪为80元。
崔雲章先生认为，全部财产属于代表第四集团军的李宗仁将军，但刘先生则主张，李宗仁将军在购买这些电台时代表的是南京政府，因此南京方面才是实际所有者。我指出，所有权问题并非工部局警务处所关切之事，双方均同意由工部局警务处暂时扣留该批财产是最佳解决方案。
代理副总监获悉了事态进展，并指示将整批无线电台及附属设备移送至东部仓库，此行动与

List of WIRELESS SETS and WIRELESS PARAPHERNALIA, property claimed
by Mr. Chan Yun-tsui (崔展雲), Engineer of the Communication Department
of the Headquarters of the 4th Army Group, as belonging to General
Li Chung-jen (李宗仁). Against Mr. Chan's claim, however, is the
contention of Mr. Liu Ngoh-nien (劉鶴年), Master of Shanghai Short
Wave Radio Station, a Branch of Nanking Military Headquarters, that these
wireless sets, etc. are in fact the property of the Nationalist Government
at Nanking as they were purchased by General Li Chung-jen (李宗仁) at a
time when he was an official of the Nationalist Government.

Now that General Li Chung-jen has been outlawed by the Nationalist
Government, Nanking, and that any wireless transmission from the
International Settlement by any Chinese military or political faction
might constitute a menace to the peace and order of the Settlement,
both parties, Mr. Chan Yun-tsui and Mr. Liu Ngoh-nien, agree to these
sets, etc. being removed by the Municipal Police from 24.D. Tongshan
Road, a dwelling house of which Mr. Chan Yun-tsui is tenant, to the
Police Eastern Depot and there detained temporarily.-
